reviews.text: Televets were great!  I was able to book an appointment within an hour, the veterinarian was attentive and treated my senior cat's UTI.  My cat is 18 but doing amazing. Initially   we had issues obtaining the prescription from 1800petmeds (at no fault of Televets).  They did everything they could to to push it through, we then tried Chewy, they were too slow as well, then Walgreens and they didn't have antibiotic in stock, finally we purchased the script from CVS...Televets contacted each pharmacy with approval until we found it in stock.  My kitty was able to be treated in the comfort of our home and quickly.  Thank you!!!!

This service was amazing! My dog ran out of his medication before we were able to get in with a new vet and they were able to help get him a short term supply quickly. I would definitely use them again!

Dr. Carla Pilla-Daniel’s was so kind and caring. She gave quality care to my pet and went above and beyond. She was quick to respond to emails and helped me find a pharmacy near to get my pets prescription the same day. I will be using her again in the future.
Knowledgeable, professional caring provider! Needed urgent Vet care on a weekend and TeleVet kept me from having to miss a day of work, as well as half the price of local weekend options. Thank you!
Kind and knowledgeable

I highly recommend Telavets!!! We are traveling and our sweet Lilly wasn’t feeling well! I had a zoom call with a vet and she was so helpful! She accessed her via zoom and prescribed her some medication and hopefully Lilly will be on the mend soon! So grateful for their help!
Quick, easy, efficient service.  Thank you!
Dr was very informing and passionate He gave me hope that i did not.  Highly recommend

AWESOME customer service! Initially had connection issue but it was taken care of immediately and a connection with another was made.  I was unable to get to my own vet due a recent hip replacement, this service allowed me to take care of my dog while healing
myself. Great service, would use again in a heart beat. Thank you

Dr Nathanial is amazing caring understanding and compassionate! He is very knowledgeable and takes the time to explain everything. He listens to concerns and does whatever is in the best interest of my kitty. He does well with elevating stress and shows he cares about my kitty and my self. Great dr! Also want to thank the office staff for checking in on my fur baby and always being kind and helpful!
Dr Donnelly was a great doctor my poodle is getting older she will be 16. She has really bad allergies and developing a heart condition. The doctor was really honest and helpful.

I moved twice in three months and my poor cat started acting aggressively on and off. I don’t have a car so Telavets was my only way to get Gabapentin and fluoxetine for her. The meds are on the way so I don’t know what will happen next, but I am rating Telavets highly because the vet was very kind and understanding (miss Hyun Han, thank you). Also I was able to get an appointment in thirty minutes flat which I really needed. Hope this helps somebody
Very friendly and caring Dr.
Dr. McGinnis was very knowledgeable and listened to my cat's issues.  She addressed the problem and may have come up with an answer after 5 years of trying with local vet practices.
Hyun Hee Han was AMAZING! She was very helpful and answered all questions my husband I had. Having a virtual vet appointment was very convenient as well.

For my dog with vet anxiety this virtual visit is perfect!!!  I just needed what seems to be an infection on his eye looked at at Dr. Alan Rakestraw was wonderful.  He was prompt, professional and very helpful!  I appreciate his advice and treatment plan for my Boo Bear and will certainly use this service again!  Thank you!

I used this service for my dog that has been having ear issues. The vet we had was fantastic. He was very well spoken and extremely knowledgeable. Smooth process. I highly recommend using this service for your pet.
Support quickly helped me out when I didn’t receive the initial teledoc link and everything went well.
Easy and helpful
It was a great experience!!  Dr. Pilla-Daniels was professional and clearly knowledgeable.  Mayhem say’s thank you!!

Dr. Carla was not only kind and understanding, she was quick to help! She even made sure my dogs prescription was approved asap to be sent to me since my car is broken down. 10/10 recommend this site. What a life saver!
Excellent service and will continue to use for my dog!

Dr Jeanne and Chris did a great job both Televets appts! Dr Jeanne diagnosed my dog through FaceTime showed her the hit spots and underbelly of my dog. The Dr was thorough and listened to us for a change! The price for the online appt was cheaper than most!!  I will continue to use this service in the future!! Great staff…
Dr. Carla Pilla is a compassionate and competent professional. I highly recommend her.

Vet was knowledgeable.  Seems that he really cares for animals.  Would recommend and use this service again.  Praying the treatment protocol he gave for my pullet is successful.  Being a chicken mom can be hard sometimes..when your animals aren't feeling well & you dont know what to do.  Having a service like this available is awesome!

Coming back again with another pet. These doctors are amazing. This whole company is amazing for those of us that work full-time for non-super serious pet health issues... This is perfect. My cat's been sneezing a little bit so I got the right medication for her. Thank you televets and Thank you, Dr. Donnelly
Well, talk about Affordable and quick care for your animals! This was a lifesaver and I’m definitely recommending them to anybody who needs a vet
Our telehealth visit was awesome. Dr. Rakestraw was kind and professional and patient. He offered sound advice and put in place a plan for our doggies. Great experience!
Awesome service highly recommend

Vet never showed up for appointment

Edit - someone called and rescheduled my appointment and a new provider and was able to diagnose and treat my dogs symptoms. Very appreciative of the quick response.
Excellent service, reasonably p[riced, no waiting, and hassle free.  I will definitely use Telavets again.

I had a great experience this weekend with TelaVets!
I just wanted to publicly commend them for my experience.
My dear Juno was eating freshpet dog food the last month, and I noticed him starting to not feel well. It started with vomiting bile every few days and progressed to diarrhea.
His regular vet could not see him for days and I didn’t feel as though it was a true emergency that warranted an animal hospital.
I was able to schedule him a telavet appointment and have him seen within 2 hours on the WEEKEND!
Meds prescribed same day to any pharmacy near us.
Our bill was $80 for some antibiotics and zofran for any nausea he might have. (Including the visit fee!)
My little guy is back to his spunky, energetic self today and I’m feeling so relieved. If you believe you have a non-urgent need but still want to be seen quickly and not wait weeks for their normal vet, I highly recommend this service!

Dr Alan was very kind. We've used tele vet 2 times and appreciate how quick and convenient it is. Having bulldogs they tend to have the same reoccurring issue. Ear infections ! Such an easy way to get them what they need so I don't have to take time from work and load them in the car which they really don't like !

This was amazing!  I was so scared because my puppy ate a toxic plant.  The vet was awesome in assessing my dog and learning what happened.  She provided excellent advice.   I had an appointment the Sunday before Memorial Day.  I’m so thankful I found this service!!!  I highly recommend!!!!

Absolutely wonderful man helped my dog. Very caring and kind Doctor. I was super impressed and I will use them again in the future. Really Happy!!! My Dog Louie is too I also wanted to add he sent the meds to local pharmacy, no hassles never even had to leave our couch. The best was it's affordable

We needed an easy and hassle free way to get a refill on an rx for our girl. She has incontinence issues and we found a medication that changed our lives and worked like a dream. However, our girl is very dog aggressive and trips to the vet are extremely stressful for everyone. Telavets had an appointment 15 minutes from the time we logged in. They were early to the visit! The doctor was so easy to talk to and knowledgeable. They were able to go through our existing script filler, Chewy, and even fulfilled the same day! I had live time texting with an awesome agent there to answer any questions while refilling the script. I HIGHLY recommend this company. We told them they have a life long customer and our girl even shook on it!

Yesterday, I brought home a new dog and needed to schedule a new patient appointment with my veterinary clinic. Unfortunately, they were booked out for two weeks. In search of a quicker solution, I found TelaVets online. Got a same day appointment!

The scheduling process was seamless, and my dog, Molly, was seen by Dr. Moppin. He was friendly, knowledgeable, and provided excellent care. Molly was diagnosed with two ear infections requiring antibiotics. TelaVets promptly sent the prescription, and ordering the medication was simple.

The cost of both the appointment and medication was very reasonable. I was so impressed with the experience that I’ve already recommended TelaVets to three people. I highly recommend their services to anyone in need of convenient, high-quality veterinary care.
This place has helped me with my puppy twice now they are very nice and friendly

I love this service! They always have availability and have extended hours. The price is competitive as well. They are super reliable and someone is always available to speak with if there are issues with the connectivity. You get prescriptions right away with no hassle. They have come in handy and are my go to telehealth provider for my little guy !

TeleVets is the best telehealth veterinarian service I’ve used. The process was seamless and the veterinarian was professional. They diagnosed my dog and the meds were sent to me shortly!  I saved myself an expensive vet visit
